decision.wording: The prior is not the mechanism; the response surface is (grid_r2 = -6.19). D20 stands as written.
decision.unit_note: The design is balanced (25 instances x exactly 2 seeds), so the mean of the 25 instance means IS the mean of the 50 campaigns -- the registered rule compares a mean against two anchors, and that mean is unit-invariant here. The dual read therefore cannot move the verdict; what it moves is the interval around it and the Wilcoxon p on every paired contrast, which are reported at both units with n=25 governing.
